card.name: Word starts before unusual spellings
card.fires_on: Responds to a short word-start piece such as Ch, Gr, Sch or Meg, where the rest of the word is still to come. It appears in web text on names and uncommon words like chandeliers, Gratz, Chianti and Megachile.

modes.label: Ch start of word
modes.description: The piece Ch or ch begins a word whose ending comes next, in common words or names.
modes.example: <<Ch>>ances are that you haven't been giving

modes.label: Gr or Sch in names
modes.description: Gr or Sch begins a proper name, such as a court case or a person's surname.

modes.label: Other word starts
modes.description: Other short beginnings like Meg inside a Latin species name, or the word for before a name.
modes.example: Leafcutter Bees (<<Meg>>achile) may also use the tunnels
